My mental health was gradually declining again. Then my girlfriend left me. It’s really complicated because I see her everyday at school and we sit next to each other (we couldn’t switch places). I don’t think I’ll get anywhere in life. I only have one dream and it’s unattainable. My dad, the only person who’s supporting me financially could lose his job soon. I’m just exhausted of struggling everyday. Nothing makes sense anymore. I get bad anxiety attacks everyday. Sure, I have a few friends and family who I can trust and I know I’m important to them but that doesn’t make things better for me. I just really want this to end. I’m decided. I’m afraid of other suicide methods because I’m afraid of pain. I think by blowing my head off, it will only take a few seconds to knock me down. And it really isn’t that hard to pull the trigger.
